column1: # Custom partition table for PaperColor — lower 8MB of 16MB flash (no OTA).
# The M5PaperColor on hand is an ESP32-S3R8 with 16MB flash. We keep one app
# slot because a full re-flash over USB is simpler than maintaining OTA slots.
# `otadata` remains because Arduino-ESP32 references it during boot
# never points anywhere meaningful with a single app0 slot. The upper 8MB stays
# unused until a concrete storage need justifies repartitioning.
# `rcdata` keeps its own 128KB NVS partition — nvs.cpp opens "rcpaper"
# pages blob has room (default nvs is 20KB total).
